geeklist.title: Short and Sweet Auction in time for the holidays.
geeklist.description:
Short and Sweet Auction in time for the holidays.
All the standard auction rules will apply for this list. You know what that's about, including:
This auction is for the continental United States ONLY.
[b]The auction will end sometime around 8pm CST, 11/9/2025. I will decide the exact time, based on how the bidding is progressing.[/b]
1. Bid in whole dollar amounts, increments of $1. 2. When bidding, include your ZipCode (e.g. $10 - 68022) 3. Buyer pays full shipping costs. I always use PirateShip to keep the costs down. Shipping will be from 68022. 4. Any starting bid (SB) and above will guarantee a sale. 5. Multiple items purchased may be packaged together to save shipping costs. 6. I will accept PayPal Friends and Family as payment. Payment is required within two days of the Total Cost quote (winning bid + shipping). 7. BGG will get their 3%. 8. Any questions, GM me.
